name: wp-webhook-framework
description: wp-env application test tooling for WP Webhook Framework

scripts.test:phpunit: wp-env run cli --env-cwd=wp-content/wpwf-framework timeout -k 5 120 vendor/bin/phpunit -c phpunit.xml.dist
scripts.test:integration: pnpm run wp-env:start && pnpm run composer:install && pnpm run test:ci && pnpm run test:phpunit && pnpm run test:concurrency
scripts.test:concurrency: wp-env run cli --env-cwd=wp-content/wpwf-framework timeout -k 5 90 php tests/concurrent-updates.php
scripts.check: pnpm run phpcs && pnpm run phpstan
scripts.phpcs: wp-env run cli --env-cwd=wp-content/wpwf-framework composer run-script phpcs
scripts.phpstan: wp-env run cli --env-cwd=wp-content/wpwf-framework composer run-script phpstan
